problem.text: Inline Markdown images lose their place in the line of text, and each one wraps onto its own line.

surfaces: Web app > channel header > inline Markdown images

rootCause.text: Once the image loads, SizeAwareImage sets display: block as an inline style on .file-preview__button. Inline styles beat stylesheets, so the inline-block rules never apply.

checks.name: Repro passes with the fix
checks.description: The Recreator's repro script exits 0 with the patch applied in the sandbox.

checks.name: Existing tests still pass
checks.description: The product's existing tests still pass with the patch applied.

solutionsTested.approach: Patch F1, for cause C1 (the root cause)
solutionsTested.why: Not verified: no patch verifier is configured.

nextStep.reason: Cause found, but no fix passes
nextStep.text: Build Mattermost 11.7.12 with patch F1 and rerun repro.py. If the repro exits 0 and the existing tests pass, the fix counts.

knownGaps.text: SizeAwareImage is shared by attachments and MM Blocks; their block layout depends on the stylesheet once the inline style is gone.
Untested cause C2: The header popover stylesheet gives .file-preview__button the wrong display value. Needs: current access.
Patch F1 was not run against the repro or the tests.
No last good version is known, so the repro was not checked on a clean build.

recreation.script:
"""Repro: inline Markdown images in the channel header wrap onto their own lines. Exit 1 = bug present."""
import sys
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

with sync_playwright() as p:
    page = p.chromium.launch().new_page()
    page.goto(f"{BASE}/{TEAM}/channels/{CHANNEL}")  # placeholders set by the sandbox
    page.wait_for_selector(".channel-header__description .file-preview__button img")
    tops = page.eval_on_selector_all(
        ".channel-header__description .file-preview__button",
        "els => els.map(e => [getComputedStyle(e).display, e.getBoundingClientRect().top])")
    # Two images and the text should share one row; display:block stacks them.
    sys.exit(1 if any(d == "block" for d, _ in tops) or len({round(t) for _, t in tops}) > 1 else 0)
